_comment: Textures removed so modern Minecraft renders its own (correct) version. Cases, all verified against vanilla old-vs-new: (1) Entity textures whose model was re-unwrapped after 1.8.9, so the old texture mis-maps: chest (Mojang rearranged the lid UV faces -> dark square on the lid) and horse (reworked in 1.11 - the 1.8.9 texture fills only ~28% of the UV the modern model reads -> mostly invisible horse). (2) Container-GUI backgrounds whose slot layout drifted so much between 1.8.9 and modern that a 1.8.9 background misaligns with modern's functional slots (inventory added an offhand slot + shifted the 2x2 crafting grid; anvil and enchanting-table GUIs were redesigned). A full art-preserving remap is complex; dropping yields correct, aligned vanilla versions and is ideal for faithful-style packs. Remove an entry to keep the custom texture (at the cost of the mis-map/misalignment). Paths relative to assets/minecraft/.
